description: Defines classes related to app settings, color themes, and board themes for a Flutter chess app, including serialization methods.

classes.name: BoardTheme
classes.description: Represents a color theme for the chess board, with serialization support.

classes.name: AppSettings
classes.description: Stores app-level settings such as theme ID and board flip state, with default and copy methods.

classes.name: AppColors
classes.description: Contains static color constants based on style guide.

classes.name: BoardThemes
classes.description: Provides predefined board themes and a method to retrieve themes by ID.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes BoardTheme and AppSettings instances to JSON.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes JSON into BoardTheme and AppSettings instances.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of AppSettings with optional modified fields.

methods.name: byId
methods.description: Retrieves a BoardTheme by its ID from predefined themes.
